messages:
jamie_ops: Quick heads up — our load test is blowing out pod packing on the GPU burst nodepool in asia-southeast1. Nodes are half-full and we're exhausting zone-level GPU allocations rather than cores. Need quota/limit bump and advice on CNI knobs.

sofia_enginfra: Which nodepool and machine type? are we hitting instance quota or something network-y (max pods / IP addresses)?

jamie_ops: Nodepool: `gpu-burst-pool` (GKE), machine type `a2-highgpu-1g` (A2/A10 class). Symptoms: lots of single-GPU pods with a sidecar -> podAffinity + topologySpread constraints lead to anti-packing. Kubelet `maxPods` is 110 but effective density is ~10 pods/node because each pod requests hostNetwork=false and we hit per-node IP exhaustion due to CNI behavior + our Istio sidecars.

mike_sre: Hmm. Two vectors: 1) regional GPU quota (CPUs/GPUs) and 2) per-subnet IP pool exhaustion from the CNI. Are you using VPC-native (alias IP) or legacy routes? Also any hostPort usage?

jamie_ops: VPC-native with GKE native CNI. No hostPort in the new jobs, but sidecars and ephemeral debug pods increase actual pod count. We also have `podAntiAffinity` for fault isolation, which spreads them. If we reduce anti-affinity we can pack more, but that defeats isolation.

sofia_enginfra: For immediate relief we can request: - increase GPUs quota in `asia-southeast1` by +60 A2 GPUs - increase regional internal IP quota (or expand the subnet secondary range) for the cluster's subnet - increase `GKE Alias IP Ranges` buffer so max pods per node net allocation rises. I'll draft a support message.

jamie_ops: Yep please. Also want to ask for a temporary raise on per-project `NETWORKS.ROUTES` if we need to create extra route ranges, and any quota on `IN_USE_ADDRESSES` in the VPC. Our quick experiment showed `kubectl describe node` returning:

```
Allocatable:
  nvidia.com/gpu: 1
  pods: 110
  cpu: 3800m
  memory: 14Gi
```

but `ip-metrics` show alias range usage at ~92% before we hit GPU quota.

mike_sre: Good details. Draft for support should include project ID, exact region, SKU (A2/A100 if used anywhere), and a brief justification that we need short-term burst capacity for load testing + long-term dedicated pool plan. Also include a contact and desired ETA.

sofia_enginfra: Draft message (copy/paste into GCP console):

```
Hello, we are requesting quota increases for project `redwood-prod-123` in `asia-southeast1` to accommodate GPU burst testing and denser pod packing on GKE.
Requested changes:
- "GPUS (NVIDIA A2)" increase by 60 (from 20 -> 80)
- "Compute Engine API in-use addresses (regional)" increase by 500
- "VPC alias IP ranges (secondary)" expansion to add /20 to subnet `gke-burst-subnet`
Reason: Our workload uses 1 GPU per pod with an Istio sidecar; podAntiAffinity and topologySpread cause low packing efficiency. We plan to run sustained load tests for 48 hours and then evaluate Dedicated capacity. Please advise on expected ETA and any temporary limits we should be aware of. Contact: jamie_ops@redwood.ai, oncall: mike_sre@redwood.ai
```

jamie_ops: This looks good. Can you also attach the `gcloud` commands to retrieve current quotas so support can triage faster?

sofia_enginfra: Sure — run:
```
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --project=redwood-prod-123
gcloud compute addresses list --filter="region:asia-southeast1 AND purpose:VPC_PEERING" --project=redwood-prod-123
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod-123
```

deploy-bot: Support case created — Case #987654321: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/987654321 (status: Pending, assigned to support-agent)

ben_platform: FYI cost impact if quota granted and we fill the burst pool: ~USD 1.2k/day for 60 A2 instances (preemptibles assumed). Might be cheaper to spin a dedicated pool in us-west2 and re-route traffic for the test window. Pros/cons here?

jamie_ops: Good point. For the test we prefer staying in asia-southeast1 to validate latency SLOs. If the quota ETA is 48-72h and GCP can't expedite, we'll fallback to the us-west pool. Please mark cost center `infra-load-tests`.

sofia_enginfra: Noted. I cc'd finance in the support case and included the cost center. Asking GCP for an expedited review. Will update here when case moves.

jamie_ops: Thanks — will patch anti-affinity rules for non-critical jobs as a short-term mitigation and start the test once we get confirmation. :thumbsup:

mike_sre: Also logging this as an ops runbook note: reduce `podAntiAffinity` for test namespace, run `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain` with `--ignore-daemonsets` for packed placement, and revert after test.

jamie_ops: Copy. ETA request to GCP requested as high-priority. I'll follow up in 2 hours.
